title: Repeated independent proxies identify reporting distortions without a known error law
checked_scope: The source's calibrated additive proxy model, extended to two repeated proxies with independent errors and a location normalization.
significance: Derives joint reporting-distortion identification from observable characteristic-function derivatives when proxy error is unknown, and separately relaxes nonvanishing known-error assumptions to dense nonzero support.
